text: You've never seen a bird pee. And you never will.
Almost no bird does. Except the ostrich.
See bird poop on a car? The white part is the pee.
Instead of watery urine, birds make uric acid, a white paste that leaves with the poop, through one exit.
No water wasted. No heavy bladder in flight.
Even in the egg, the chick keeps it as solid crystals, so it can't poison itself.
So that white splat on your car? Bird pee.
And this pigeon? Still never peed.
